# Non-linear age and Glu lower in females

```{r Figure S6, fig.align = "center", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,  results = "asis", fig.height = 7, fig.width=10, fig.cap= "**Fig S6: Age-related trajectories and sex differences in 7T MRS glutamate, GABA, and their ratio at visit 1. (A–C)** Age at visit 1 had a trend-wise non-linear effect on the glutamate concentrations with a minimum around 70 years (F(2, 83.44) = 2.77, P = 0.069, Model 1), while GABA and the glutamate/GABA ratio exhibited no substantial association. **(D–F)** Female participants showed lower glutamate levels than males with an estimated difference of -0.82 mmol/L (95% CI = [-1.27; -0.37], P < 0.001). No sex differences were observed for GABA or the glutamate/GABA ratio. *Abbreviations: AD = Alzheimer’s Disease, Aβ+ = Amyloid-beta positive by plasma p-Tau181, CN = Cognitively Normal, GABA = Gamma-Aminobutyric Acid, MCI = Mild Cognitive Impairment, MRS = Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy.*"}

ylim_min_glu <- 9.9
ylim_max_glu <- 17.6
ylim_min_gaba <- 1.75 
ylim_max_gaba <- 4.80
ylim_min_glu_gaba <- 0.95
ylim_max_glu_gaba <- 1.90

plot_age_emmeans <- function(model, y_lab, data, outcome_var, size_var = NULL, age_seq = seq(50, 90, by = 1)) {
  
  # emmeans: Alterseffekt berechnen bei visit 1 (year = 0) und sex = 1
  em_age <- emmeans(model,
                    ~ age_bl,
                    at = list(age_bl = age_seq),
                    cov.reduce = list(year = function(x) 0, sex = function(x) 1))# Jahr = 0 (Baseline), sex = female
  
  # Konfidenzintervalle sicherstellen
  em_age <- regrid(em_age)
  
  # Daten fürs Plotten
  df_em <- as.data.frame(em_age)
  df_points <- data %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(outcome_var)) & visit == "t1")
  
  # Plot 
  plot <- ggplot(df_em, aes(x = age_bl, y = emmean)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), fill = "#264653", alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2, color = "#264653")
  
  if (!is.null(size_var)) {
    plot <- plot +
      geom_point(
        data = df_points,
        aes(x = age_bl, y = !!sym(outcome_var), color = diagnose_group, size = !!sym(size_var)),
        alpha = 0.8
      ) +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.8, 2.5), name = "CRLB-based size")
  } else {
    plot <- plot +
      geom_point(
        data = df_points,
        aes(x = age_bl, y = !!sym(outcome_var), color = diagnose_group),
        size = 1.5,
        alpha = 0.8
      )
  }
  
  plot +
    scale_color_manual(values = diagnose_colors, name = "Clinical Diagnose at Visit 1") +
    labs(x = "Age at Visit 1 [years]", y = y_lab, color = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

A <- plot_age_emmeans(lmer_long_glu_groupwise, "Glutamate [mmol/L]", data = NeuroMET, outcome_var = "glu", size_var = "glu_CRLB")
B <- plot_age_emmeans(lmer_long_gaba_groupwise, "GABA [mmol/L]", data = NeuroMET, outcome_var = "gaba", size_var = "gaba_CRLB")+
    guides(size = "none")
C <- plot_age_emmeans(lmer_long_glu_gaba_groupwise, "log(Glutamate / GABA)", data = NeuroMET, outcome_var = "glu_gaba", size_var = "glu_gaba_CRLB")+
    guides(size = "none")

D <- NeuroMET %>%
    filter(visit == "t1") %>%

    mutate(
        biomarker = factor(biomarker, levels = c("glu", "gaba", "glu_gaba")),
        sex = factor(sex, labels = c(glue("Male \nGlutamate Mean \n{mean_male_glu}[mmol/L]"),

    ) %>%
    filter(biomarker == "glu") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = value, fill = sex)) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, lwd = 0.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = diagnose_group, size = glu_CRLB),

    labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "Glutamate [mmol/L]") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2A9D8F", "#866f85")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = diagnose_colors, name = "Clinical Diagnose at Visit 1") +

        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")

)
